when.label: Suppressed by mission and administration; documented by Handy in 1922, revived since the 1980s

practice.note: The densest body coverage recorded anywhere in the Pacific.

text.what: The Marquesas: coverage so complete that Willowdean Handy's 1922 survey had to be drawn panel by panel to record it.
text.story: Handy's *Tattooing in the Marquesas* is a Bishop Museum bulletin, out of copyright, and it is a catalogue of motifs recorded when very few marked people were left. The name says the method: *patu tiki*, to strike the image.
